name: axiom-contract-engineering
description: The engineering discipline of typed cross-boundary contracts — contract-first boundaries with one authority per record class, silent-default elimination (absent ≠ zero, validity masks, fail-loud readers), schema versioning where any change in meaning is a new version and compatibility fails closed, deterministic resolution with no covert channels, blinding by construction (excluded fields absent from the schema, not ignored), canonical content-addressed identity, contract-layer dependency direction with import-lint gates, versioned policy parameters, definition lifecycle (draft → approved → locked via recorded events), and contract testing (golden fixtures, round-trips, canonicalisation properties, schema-invalid rejection, authority tests). Router + 10 sheets, 3 commands, 2 agents.
